claim.value: Reliably short queue waits would weaken queue congestion as the direct source of an hour-long export.
claim.scope: A hypothetical diagnostic relation limited to queue congestion as the direct source; it does not eliminate every possible queue contribution.

contract_question: Under the stated conditions, does the transferred mechanism license the claimed relation between each hypothetical outcome and its stated evidential or operational consequence, without assuming that the outcome has actually occurred?

target.title: Intermittent document export delays
target.frame: A hosted document service exports customer workspaces overnight. Median export time is stable, but roughly one in twenty exports now takes more than an hour instead of ten minutes. Export traces include queue entry, worker start, object reads and archive upload; trace coverage differs across worker versions. Customers cannot be asked to rerun large exports during business hours. The engineering team must plan a safe investigation and choose the next deployment action.

instrument.state: Several plausible explanations can account for an uncertain situation, and available evidence may fit more than one of them.
instrument.operation: State the competing explanations explicitly, evaluate each item of evidence against all of them, emphasize evidence that is inconsistent with particular explanations, and test the sensitivity of the resulting comparison to uncertain evidence or assumptions.
instrument.signal: The evidence forms a comparative pattern of consistency and inconsistency across the competing explanations, with some items discriminating among them more strongly than others.
instrument.inference: Explanations with greater important inconsistency can be weakened or eliminated, leaving a smaller set of alternatives that better survives the observed evidence.
instrument.limit: Missing hypotheses, dependent or unreliable evidence, subjective consistency judgments, poor assessment of diagnosticity, and shared assumptions can make the comparison misleading. Surviving contradiction is not proof that the remaining explanation is true.

P001.text: Act on existing export records and traces, distinguishing the stable median from the reported roughly one-in-twenty exports exceeding an hour.

P002.text: Compare explicit, potentially coexisting explanations: queue congestion or worker shortages; worker-version regressions; slow or retried object reads; slow archive uploads; and workspace size or composition differences.

P003.text: Treat these as hypotheses, not findings.

P004.text: Trace coverage varies by worker version; availability of comparable timestamps, workload metadata and resource metrics remains uncertain.

P009.text: Prioritize contradictions over counts of supporting items: for example, reliably short queue waits would weaken queue congestion as the direct source of an hour-long export.

P027.text: Missing spans are unknown evidence, not proof that a phase was fast.

P028.text: Incomplete exports may be absent from completed-export samples and must be accounted for where records permit.

P029.text: Version, workload and overnight load may be confounded; overlapping spans, inconsistent clocks, retries and dependent measurements can distort comparisons.

P030.text: Rare delays require enough comparable exposure to make absence informative, so a short clean canary cannot establish resolution.

P031.text: Specify the observation window and required exposure before judging it; if exposure or coverage is inadequate, report the result as inconclusive and continue only within the safety bounds.

P032.text: Subjective consistency judgments, omitted causes and shared assumptions may leave the ranking wrong.

P033.text: Surviving contradiction does not prove a cause, and instrumentation or test workloads may change the behavior being investigated.
